expense.emptyText: Add repairs, fuel, salaries and rent so profit is calculated correctly.

finance.meta: What the business and each bike earned
finance.outstandingHint: For bookings in this period, with deposits
finance.hint: Income is counted by booking start date, as on the dashboard, including future confirmed bookings in the period. A deposit is not income unless something is deducted from it.
finance.purchaseHint: Used to calculate payback. Only admins can see it.
finance.paybackHint: Payback is the bike's all-time profit against its purchase price. Set the price under Fleet. General expenses are not split across bikes.

tracking.noPositions: No bikes on the map yet
tracking.noPositionsText: Open a bike and connect a GPS tracker.
tracking.purchaseHint: Set the purchase price under Fleet to see payback.

gps.waitingText: The tracker is connected. The position appears once the device sends coordinates.
gps.notConnectedText: An admin can connect a tracker on this page.
gps.intro: Connect a tracker and the bike appears on the map with a 30-day track. A phone with the Traccar Client app or a GPS beacon will work.
gps.step1: Install the Traccar Client app on the phone kept in the bike.
gps.step2: Paste this address into the server address field in the app settings.
gps.step3: Turn on sending. The position appears here within a minute.
gps.secret: The address contains a secret, so do not share it. If it leaks, disconnect GPS and connect again to get a new one.
gps.hardware: Connect a GPS beacon through Traccar Server
gps.hardwareText: Beacons use their own protocols, so a Traccar server receives them. Enter the device ID from Traccar (usually the IMEI). Server setup is in docs/gps.md.
gps.hardwareOff: Beacons use their own protocols, so a Traccar server receives them. To forward points here, set GPS_FORWARD_SECRET on the server. Setup is in docs/gps.md.
gps.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect the tracker? The current address will stop working.
